source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means (risk TRUE for role analyst) or action change; critical cases require deny. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90. Trusted means context sandbox with any role except analyst; a trusted delete prefers allow at priority 80. Action export in context internal prefers deny at priority 70. Role admin and context partner prefers review at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid review. All other declared roles prefer allow at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means (risk TRUE for role analyst) or action change; critical cases require deny.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.role == analyst)) or (event.action == change)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.context == sandbox) and (event.role != analyst)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.context == internal) and (event.risk == UNKNOWN)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = deny

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRiskCase:
    when event.risk == UNKNOWN
    then prefer label = review priority 90

rule TrustedDeleteCase:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == delete)
    then prefer label = allow priority 80

rule ExportInternalCase:
    when (event.action == export) and (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = deny priority 70

rule AdminPartnerCase:
    when (event.role == admin) and (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = review priority 40

rule TrustedForbidReviewCase:
    when Trusted(event)
    then forbid label = review

rule OtherRolesCase:
    when event.role in {operator, admin}
    then prefer label = allow priority 1

deployment_description: Classify one structured event using the supplied compiled instructions. The allowed outputs are allow, deny, review, uncertain. These names are arbitrary symbols, so do not infer their meaning. Copy the output stated by the matching compiled instruction.
